title: API Composition

validation.research: Five primary sources: Chris Richardson’s API Composition and Database per Service catalogs, Microsoft’s Gateway Aggregation and microservice Data considerations, and Python 3.11 Coroutines and Tasks. API Composition is the established pattern name; API Composer is a component role and is not made into an alias article. Gateway Aggregation is related placement guidance, while the existing messaging Aggregator has a different group-completion concern. Owner API reads, in-memory identity joins, size limits, independent observations, dependency latency/availability, optional-versus-required data, authorization context, and cooperative cancellation are explicit. No gateway, parallel fan-out, materialized database, global snapshot, or hard wall-clock guarantee is assumed.

runnable_example.verification: Exact demo output and EUR cent formatting; all order/customer response permutations join by identity, deduplicate shared C7 into one customer batch, and preserve requested card order; response objects and frozen DTOs remain independent/unmutated; missing, duplicate, unexpected, or oversized identities fail the required query; invalid requests/budgets call no APIs; exact 1/50-row, 64/65-character, zero-cent DTO, and 0.01/1-second budget boundaries; one timeout context spans both dependent calls; real expiration during either read runs cleanup and returns a typed timeout error, while an adapter-local timeout is not mislabeled as solely the total deadline; transport errors fail required composition and unknown errors propagate; external cancellation propagates with request cleanup and no surviving task; differing owner-local revisions are preserved without implying a shared snapshot. Validated DTO fields/authorized labels are adapter preconditions. No HTTP, response decoder, credentials, retry loop, storage, cache, parallel fan-out, or distributed snapshot test is inferred.

example_limits: Original Python 3.11+ asynchronous API simulation. composition.py accepts 1–50 distinct ASCII order IDs of 1–64 characters and a finite 0.01–1-second budget. Owner adapters are assumed to provide validated immutable DTOs with valid identity/reference fields, nonnegative integer euro-cent totals, positive owner-local revisions, authorized labels, and bounded response bodies. The composition code enforces request bounds and exact response identity/cardinality, deduplicates sorted customer IDs for one dependent batch, joins by identity, preserves request order, and reports separate observed order/customer revisions. Both APIs and all required identities must be available. One cooperative timeout spans both reads; timeouts and transport errors produce visible failures, cancellation propagates, and adapters retain request cleanup responsibilities. No HTTP transport/decoder, credential handling, retry loop, storage, cache, parallel fan-out, distributed snapshot, blocking-code preemption, or hard wall-clock limit. Tested response permutations, missing/duplicate/unexpected/oversized responses, invalid bounds, real expiration, cancellation cleanup with no surviving task, transport/unknown errors, immutable inputs, and independent owner observations.
